description:

The owning row is task-3506e04abcef4fc3a69299ca238ae1b3 (DONE, the Activate card); full evidence is comment-f64e380cbb614b9cad68ff6bda0c755a there. task-ac9d5e2d is BLOCKED on this row: it cannot prove a browser-only fresh start that does not complete.

THE DEFECT, measured not inferred. On a genuinely empty store the browser Activate chain runs three steps green and then refuses:
  Activate the project - refused ACTIVATION_POLICY_UNMEASURED @ DAEMON_ACTIVATION_RECEIPTS
(`cr.activate.step.project.activate` carries data-ok="false"; register, bind_repository and provider.probe all carry "true".)

WHY. `ACTIVATION_CHAIN_KINDS` (apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/activation-port.ts:29) is [project.register, project.bind_repository, provider.probe, project.activate] and deliberately mirrors `COMMAND_PREREQUISITES` (apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-sequence.ts:31-35), which for project.activate lists only those three. But the activation witness is minted from MEASURED receipts and the `policy` receipt is the digest of the INSTALLED SLICE SET (activation-receipts.ts:38). Nothing installed means nothing to measure, so the activate refuses. A fresh `POST /activation/read` returns blocking:["provider","policy"]; provider.probe clears provider and nothing in the browser chain clears policy. `POST /affordances/read` on that same fresh store offers policy.install, so the daemon is offering the step the card never dispatches.

WHY NOTHING CAUGHT IT: every other lane seeds, and DEMO_SEED_KINDS installs policy before activate, so the receipt is always already measured. Only `seed: "NONE"` exposes it.

THE DESIGN CALL IS DELIBERATELY LEFT OPEN, because it is not a worker's to make silently: (a) add "policy.install" to COMMAND_PREREQUISITES["project.activate"] so every derived chain gains it, at the cost of changing a shared table with other consumers; or (b) add it to ACTIVATION_CHAIN_KINDS alone, which contradicts that constant's own docblock about holding no preference of its own. Whoever plans this must enumerate the consumers of COMMAND_PREREQUISITES before choosing (global rail 19).

ALREADY EXISTS, do not rebuild: the policy.install payload shape at live-dispatch-payloads.ts:98 and the operator words at work-labels.ts:44.
